neighbours.label: The start of the second branch of an 'or' alternative ('Pass the exam or get your money back', 'Either P is justified or P is not', 'or else'), firing on the word after 'or'; the same sentences joined with 'and' stay quiet.
fire: Return the item within a month or receive store credit.
Either the bridge is repaired or it must close.
Finish your homework, or else you can't go out.
You can take the bus or walk to the station.
Either the witness lied or the camera was wrong.
Book online or pay at the door.
The patient must rest, or the wound will reopen.
Either we leave now or we miss the train.
quiet: Return the item within a month and receive a refund.
The bridge is old and it must close.
Finish your homework, and then you can go out.
You can take the bus to the station.
The witness lied and the camera was wrong.
Book online and pay at the door.
The patient must rest, and the wound will heal.
We leave now and we catch the train.

notes: Card: ' or' x3, ' to' x2, ' get', ' is', Arabic أن after أو, ' else', ' while' (Pass in first attempt or⟦ get⟧ your money Back; Either P is justified or P⟦ is⟧ not; or⟦ else⟧). Exploratory probe: 'or get your money back' 0.34, 'Either ... or it is false' 0.38, 'or else' 0.17; 'and' versions 0.004-0.005.
